note: An issue-driven package deploy: the deploy job runs on issues (opened, edited, labeled) and pastes github.event.issue.body and github.event.issue.title into a shell, in a job holding INLED_REPO_PAT (the token that uploads to the package repository) and a declared contents: write token. The admin check is a shell step earlier in the job, which the facts cannot read. An untrusted expression into secrets and a write token with no proven impact is High; main is unprotected and the path's token writes the repository, so the branch gate amplifies it one tier to Critical.
